statusLine.command: sh -c 'if [ -x .claude/scripts/mnemos-statusline.sh ]; then exec .claude/scripts/mnemos-statusline.sh; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-statusline.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-statusline.sh"; fi'

hooks.command: if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-pre-compact.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-pre-compact.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-pre-compact.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-pre-compact.sh"; fi; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-post-compact-inject.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-post-compact-inject.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-post-compact-inject.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-post-compact-inject.sh"; fi; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-pre-edit.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-pre-edit.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-pre-edit.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-pre-edit.sh"; fi; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/tessera-decision-surface.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/tessera-decision-surface.sh"; fi; for d in bin scripts; do r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/$d/tessera-degraded"; [ -x "$r" ] && exec "$r" --component decision-surface --reason hook-unavailable --detail "wired hook tessera-decision-surface.sh is missing or not executable; it has never run"; done; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-post-tool.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-post-tool.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-post-tool.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-post-tool.sh"; fi; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-stop-checkpoint.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-stop-checkpoint.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-stop-checkpoint.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-stop-checkpoint.sh"; fi; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-stop-ingest.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-stop-ingest.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-stop-ingest.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-stop-ingest.sh"; fi; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/tessera-gate-scan.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/tessera-gate-scan.sh"; fi; for d in bin scripts; do r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/$d/tessera-degraded"; [ -x "$r" ] && exec "$r" --component gate-scan --reason hook-unavailable --detail "wired hook tessera-gate-scan.sh is missing or not executable; it has never run"; done; exit 0

if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-session-start.sh" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/scripts/mnemos-session-start.sh"; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-session-start.sh" ]; then exec "$HOME/.claude/templates/mnemos-session-start.sh"; fi; exit 0
